description: Inline commands (@b, @e, @c, @p, @ref with a quoted title) render as MyST markup, and a wrapped line starting with @ref stays prose rather than being read as a block command.

expected.brief: A wrapped sentence about {cpp:any}`Widget` stays one sentence.
detail: Emphasis: **bold**, *italic*, `code` and `x`. See {cpp:any}`the divide function <divide>` too. An address like user@b.example is left alone, and `foo`. keeps its stop.
